methodology.order: Sequential fresh workers, alternating checkout order on every repetition.
methodology.importMs: Dynamic source graph import and module initialization, including the catalogue.
methodology.trackMs: The real clear-weather, non-flat Track constructor, before contact creation.
methodology.contactMs: The first uninstrumented real TrackContactMesh constructor: mesh plus BVH.
methodology.warmBVHMs: BVH-only rebuilds of those unchanged mesh arrays after one untimed rebuild; GC before each. Only the final cold worker per checkout collects warm samples.
methodology.processWallMs: Full child lifetime, including hashes, queries, and optional warm samples; not a startup-only metric.
methodology.contactReadySinceProcessTimeOriginMs: Child performance.now() immediately after the first contact construction; excludes subsequent verification and warm rebuilding.
methodology.rowRule: 8192 unless circuit.samples is set, then max(8192, ceil(track.length / 0.9)), matching Track.cast.
methodology.proof: SHA-256 of every mesh array, every binary node field, every ordered triangle ID, and tagged binary contact query outputs/counts. No epsilon comparison.
methodology.scope: Construction measurements on three real paved tracks. No rendering, GPU, FPS, off-road deformation or driving-performance claim.
